entities.summary: Zahir Shah, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Modernization and Monarchy (1933–1973). Preceded by Zahir Shah Era and Amanullah Khan. Their legacy influenced Saur (April) Revolution brings the communist PDPA to power.
